note: What was merged: get_scheme_info and check_eligibility became one tool, check_scheme_and_eligibility (the date of birth is optional). The citizen server now has 7 tools; the officer server is unchanged.
Before and after, on the same 12 invented citizens: 12 of 14 passed before, 12 of 12 after. The citizen server's cost before any call fell from 4,787 to 4,721 tokens.

What we learned: we also merged the two link tools, and the small model then lost the verification link after a person pasted an OTP, so we kept them separate. A merge saves little (a few percent of the tool definitions, 1–2% of a conversation); conversation length matters far more. The merged check needed "call it first, on its own" wording, or the assistant saved details before seeing a refusal.
comparison.method: Local runs with the same settings both times: Claude Code with claude-haiku-5-5, a Haiku simulated person, the 12 citizen people (the 'before' round adds 3 runs of the grandson). Runs where the simulated person broke their card are not counted. Token figures come from one run per person, so they are indicative only.
